theme_and_archetype.description: A high-contrast, modern dark theme representing electricity and technical precision. Deep obsidian backgrounds paired with striking electric yellow and cyan accents to create a professional yet bold impression.

rules.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-yellow-500

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for sections. Asymmetric bento grids for services and gallery.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) to maintain a technical, engineered feel.
layout_and_spacing.cards: Use 'Grid Borders' style. 1px borders with subtle hover glows. Avoid heavy soft drop shadows; use sharp inset borders or glowing drop-shadows on hover.

components_strategy.header: Sticky top navigation. Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Include Logo, 4 links (Usluge, Projekti, O nama, Česta pitanja), and CTA button.
components_strategy.hero: High impact. Left aligned massive typography. Background image with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70 or gradient) so text pops. CTA button should have a neon electric yellow hover effect.
components_strategy.services: Bento Grid layout. 5 services. Cards must have a technical border and a subtle cyan or yellow line on hover.
components_strategy.gallery: Asymmetrical grid or masonry showing actual work. Hover effects to reveal project name/type.
components_strategy.faq: Shadcn Accordion customized with sharp borders, dark backgrounds, and bright yellow icons for open/close state.
components_strategy.contact: Large, commanding footer/contact section. NO FORM. Display massive 'MAILTO' link button. Phone number and address in large typography.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-yellow-400 text-black font-bold hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-all. Secondary CTA: border border-yellow-400 text-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-400/10.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons/cards must have clear hover states (color shift + slight transform). Use border color transitions to electric blue/yellow.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Fade in and slide up for sections using framer-motion. Keep it professional, not overly bouncy.

hero_bg.description: Senior electrician working on a panel. Apply heavy dark gradient overlay.

gallery.description: Solar panel installation on a roof
Electrician testing industrial panel with multimeter

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all user-facing text in Croatian as requested.
Do NOT build a contact form. Only use a mailto: link for the primary contact action.
Build a single-page structure with smooth scrolling to section IDs.
Strictly follow the dark theme and the electric yellow/cyan accents for visual pop.
Ensure all text is highly readable (APCA contrast) against the dark background.
Use framer-motion for simple scroll reveal animations.
